holdout_card.fact_statement: Ben Winston produced the cultural presentation by Los Angeles for the 2024 Summer Olympics closing ceremony.
holdout_card.source_span: British-American producer Ben Winston and his studio Fulwell 73 were commissioned to produce the cultural presentation by Los Angeles
